description: Source code for CLI plugin management in the openclaw project, including plugin registration, command loading, and configuration handling.

methods.name: canRegisterPluginCliLazily
methods.description: Checks if plugin CLI commands can be registered lazily based on descriptors and commands.

methods.name: hasIgnoredAsyncPluginRegistration
methods.description: Determines if the plugin registry has entries indicating ignored async registration.

methods.name: mergeCliRegistrars
methods.description: Merges CLI registrars from runtime and metadata registries, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: resolvePluginCliLoadContext
methods.description: Resolves context for plugin CLI loading, including configuration, workspace directory, and logger.

methods.name: loadPluginCliMetadataRegistry
methods.description: Loads plugin CLI metadata registry asynchronously.

methods.name: loadPluginCliCommandRegistry
methods.description: Loads plugin CLI command registry, falling back if async registration is ignored.

methods.name: getPluginCliCommandDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves descriptors for plugin CLI commands, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: registerPluginCliCommands
methods.description: Registers plugin CLI commands into the provided command program, supporting eager and lazy modes.
